name: Business Websites
headline: A clear website for your *small business*.
promise: A one-page or three-page website that tells customers what you do, what it costs and how to reach you, built for phones first. One page is ₹7,999 and goes live 2 working days after ready-to-build; three pages are ₹17,999 and take 7 working days.

included.title: One clear job per page
included.text: Each page leads to one action: a WhatsApp message, a call or an enquiry. Your services, prices and location sit where a visitor looks first.

included.title: Built for the phone first
included.text: Most of your visitors will open the site on a phone, so the layout, buttons and text sizes are designed there first and then widened for a computer.

included.title: WhatsApp and call buttons
included.text: One tap opens a WhatsApp chat with a message already typed, or starts a call. No form is needed for a customer to reach you.

included.title: Basic technical SEO
included.text: Page titles and descriptions, a sitemap and structured data that describe your business, and a Google Search Console submission at launch. Google decides rankings.

included.title: Your content, arranged well
included.text: We format the text, photos and details you send into a clean layout. Writing your content from scratch is not part of the package.

included.title: One revision round
included.text: One consolidated list of reasonable changes inside the agreed design, collected together and done together before launch.

process.text: Your business, what customers should be able to do on the site and when you want it. No technical brief needed.
Open the working demo for your kind of business. For suitable projects we prepare a homepage concept you can review free.
Pages, features, content, timeline and costs are written down. You approve them, then make the first payment.
Counted from ready-to-build. You review a staging link, we make the agreed revisions, then the site goes live.

faqs.a: For one page, yes, counted from ready-to-build: your content, access and first payment are with us and the scope is agreed. Three pages take 7 working days.

faqs.q: What do you need from me?
faqs.a: Your business details, logo, photos and the text for each page, plus access to your domain if you have one. We tell you what is missing before the clock starts.

faqs.q: What if I need more than one page?
faqs.a: The Business package covers three agreed pages for ₹17,999. More pages, an online store or booking are scoped and priced by written quote.

faqs.q: Will my site show up on Google?
faqs.a: We set up the technical basics and submit the site to Google Search Console. Google alone decides if and when a page is indexed or ranked, so nobody can honestly guarantee it.

faqs.q: How do I know the site is working after launch?
faqs.a: Enquiries arrive on your WhatsApp or phone, and Search Console shows the searches that brought visitors. Optional maintenance after launch is quoted separately.

cta: Tell us about your business and we will reply with the matching demo, the price and the next step.
